logging_target.description: Where to send logs: 'syslog' for system logging, 'file' to write to a dedicated log file

log_file_path.description: Path to the log file when logging_target is 'file'

log_level.description: Minimum level of messages to log (debug, info, notice, warning, error, crit, alert, emerg)

log_timestamp_format.description: Format of timestamps in logs: 'none', 'date', 'full', or 'iso8601'

event_handler.description: List of event handlers to register. Each handler runs an external command on cluster events.

name.description: A unique identifier for this handler block

command.description: The command to execute when triggered; should be an absolute path and handle arguments safely

timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the command to finish; 0 means no timeout

events.description: Types of cluster events to trigger this handler: 'cluster', 'quorum', 'node', 'quorum_change', 'votingmember', 'all'

user.description: System user to run the command as (optional, may be ignored on some systems)

group.description: System group to run the command as (optional, may be ignored on some systems)
